options.content: Live or pinned strategy-to-execution ladder. Latest mode follows the newest ControllerDiagnostics event; pinned mode uses the selected target frame. Every chart uses the same raw-ladder price/qty frame; bid is green, ask is red, and hidden black axis anchors keep scales aligned.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT e.payload
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
    AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
    AND (
      '${target_frame_mode}' = 'latest'
      OR e.event_id = ${target_frame_event_id:sqlstring}
    )
    AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  ORDER BY e.ts DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
orders AS (
  SELECT CASE lower(trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'side', '')))
  WHEN 'buy' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'bid' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'sell' THEN 'ask'
  WHEN 'ask' THEN 'ask'
  ELSE 'unknown'
END AS series,
         CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS price,
         CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'qty', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'qty', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS value
  FROM latest l
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    COALESCE(l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'ladder', 'orders'], '[]'::jsonb)
  ) AS o(value)
  WHERE CASE lower(trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'side', '')))
  WHEN 'buy' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'bid' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'sell' THEN 'ask'
  WHEN 'ask' THEN 'ask'
  ELSE 'unknown'
END IN ('bid', 'ask')
    AND CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END IS NOT NULL
),
axis_points AS (
  SELECT CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(axis_o.value->>'price', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(axis_o.value->>'price', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS price,
         CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(axis_o.value->>'qty', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(axis_o.value->>'qty', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS value
  FROM latest l
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    COALESCE(l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'ladder', 'orders'], '[]'::jsonb)
  ) AS axis_o(value)
  WHERE CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(axis_o.value->>'price', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(axis_o.value->>'price', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END IS NOT NULL
),
axis_frame AS (
  SELECT MIN(price) AS price_min,
         MAX(price) AS price_max,
         GREATEST(MAX(value), 0.0) AS qty_max
  FROM axis_points
  WHERE value > 0
),
axis_rows AS (
  SELECT 'axis range' AS series, price_min AS price, 0.0 AS value
  FROM axis_frame
  WHERE price_min IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'axis range' AS series, price_max AS price, 0.0 AS value
  FROM axis_frame
  WHERE price_max IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'axis range' AS series, price_min AS price, qty_max AS value
  FROM axis_frame
  WHERE price_min IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'axis range' AS series, price_max AS price, qty_max AS value
  FROM axis_frame
  WHERE price_max IS NOT NULL
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT series, price, SUM(value) AS value
  FROM orders
  WHERE value > 0
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT series, price, value
FROM grouped
UNION ALL
SELECT series, price, value
FROM axis_rows
ORDER BY price, series

  WHEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'qty', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'qty', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS value
  FROM latest l
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    COALESCE(l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'rules_valid', 'rejections'], '[]'::jsonb)
  ) AS o(value)
  WHERE CASE lower(trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'side', '')))
  WHEN 'buy' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'bid' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'sell' THEN 'ask'
  WHEN 'ask' THEN 'ask'
  ELSE 'unknown'
END IN ('bid', 'ask')
    AND CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(o.value->>'price', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE(o.value->>'reason', '') = 'rules_min_notional'
),
axis_points AS (
  SELECT CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(axis_o.value->>'price', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(axis_o.value->>'price', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS price,
         CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(axis_o.value->>'qty', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(axis_o.value->>'qty', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS value
  FROM latest l
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    COALESCE(l.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', 'ladder', 'orders'], '[]'::jsonb)
  ) AS axis_o(value)
  WHERE CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(axis_o.value->>'price', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(axis_o.value->>'price', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END IS NOT NULL
),
axis_frame AS (
  SELECT MIN(price) AS price_min,
         MAX(price) AS price_max,
         GREATEST(MAX(value), 0.0) AS qty_max
  FROM axis_points
  WHERE value > 0
),
axis_rows AS (
  SELECT 'axis range' AS series, price_min AS price, 0.0 AS value
  FROM axis_frame
  WHERE price_min IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'axis range' AS series, price_max AS price, 0.0 AS value
  FROM axis_frame
  WHERE price_max IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'axis range' AS series, price_min AS price, qty_max AS value
  FROM axis_frame
  WHERE price_min IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'axis range' AS series, price_max AS price, qty_max AS value
  FROM axis_frame
  WHERE price_max IS NOT NULL
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT series, price, SUM(value) AS value
  FROM orders
  WHERE value > 0
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT series, price, value
FROM grouped
UNION ALL
SELECT series, price, value
FROM axis_rows
ORDER BY price, series

SELECT
  e.event_id AS __value,
  (
    'step ' || COALESCE(e.payload->>'frame_step', '?')
    || ' / t_end ' || COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '?')
    || ' / created ' || COALESCE(e.payload->>'created_at_ms', '?')
  ) AS __text
FROM mm_events e
WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY e.ts DESC
LIMIT 100
